resources.string: You don\'t have any canvases yet. Tap “New canvas” to create one and get started.
Drawing, text, and shape suggestions; suggestions for selections and 3D shapes
This canvas will be permanently deleted. Continue?

Backend address (for upcoming AI features). Your drawings are not sent to the server; they are stored only on this device. When testing on a phone, enter your computer\'s Wi-Fi address (e.g. 192.168.1.20:4747); Telefonda-Ac.bat sets this automatically.
Save a color you picked from the palette with +; keep it within easy reach right here.
Press and hold a color to delete it.
No drawings yet. Every shape you draw appears here as a separate element.
Select elements to group, move, or recolor them.
Drag on the canvas to move
Nothing saved yet. Use the Save button to save canvases as PNG, JPEG, PDF or CBZ; everything you save is listed here.
This image will be permanently deleted from the device.
Image file not found; it may have been deleted from the gallery.

Zooms in on the point you tap · Drag: pan · Two fingers: zoom
Drag the selected elements on the canvas
Drag to rotate to any angle (snaps to 15° steps)
Corner: proportional · Edge: one direction · Drag inside: from center
Drag the edges or corners of the paper to resize it
Tap an element to select it (or use Select mode)

Pressure: stroke thickness, darkness, and texture density
First select the lines whose gaps you want to fill
No gaps to fill were found between the selected elements
All art brushes · landscape and portrait shapes
Note pens · math and geometry shapes
Drag the frame\'s edges · Drag inside: move · Anything outside is hidden, not deleted
Drag on the canvas to draw · Tap: add at default size
Tap the canvas to add text or drag to draw its box · Tap text: edit
Choose a shape, then drag on the canvas to draw it. The selected brush, color, and thickness are used.
Drag or tap to place the diagram.
Tap an edge: add point · Drag a point: move
Tap the shape: split it at that spot (the break appears on top of the shape)
Tap two points in turn: connect them directly
Choose a type, then drag on the canvas to place it.
Type, then confirm when you\'re done.
Drag the vanishing points on the canvas
Tap a step or arrow · Drag from the + handle: drop on a step to connect, drop on empty space to create a new step
Tap the edge of the step the arrow should go to (middle: automatic) · tap empty space for a new step
The selected element is cropped · The part outside is hidden, not deleted
The location and default resolution can be changed in Settings.
Images saved in total: %1$d (one per page)
The folder where images are saved, plus the default resolution and format of the save dialog.
Couldn\'t get write permission for this folder
Tap the edge of the step where the arrow should start (middle: automatic)
The chosen color becomes the fill color of the selected elements · Elements: %1$d
Tap a part to select it · drag to move
Drag: move · top handle: rotate · Separate: make it a separate element
Draw a straight line to add it to the shape
Draw a curve with your finger to add it to the shape (it gets smoothed)
Tap inside a region: fill · tap its outline: line color
Access to the errors, warnings, and all logs the app writes while running
Tap the parts to separate · the selected ones together become a new element
Tap the parts to split · each selected part becomes a separate element
Choose a formula, then tap the canvas or draw a box. The formula is added as text; unknowns and coefficients can be changed later.
Type in the part you want to change; the formula on the canvas updates right away.
Example: frac{a}{b}, x^{2}, sqrt{x}, int_{0}^{1} f(x),dx. Editable part: @a
Tap to add the formula, or draw a box.
Drag a point; tap a line to add a point, double-tap a point to delete it.
Tap the numbers, values, and axis names to change them.
Applies to selected parts (%1$d). This style is also used when adding lines and curves.
No part selected: applies to the whole shape.
Tap the numbers, values, axis names, and formula on the graph to change them.
You can enter a number, a fraction, or text like π; leave it empty to restore the default.
Crop the image, convert it to a vector shape, or draw a path over it with the pen.
The image\'s edges are detected and turned into editable lines (no fill). You can move their points with Edit shape, change the curvature of the lines, and color the areas with Fill area.
Tap to add a corner, drag to add a curve point; tapping the first point closes the path.
New elements are added to the active layer. A hidden layer isn\'t drawn; elements on a locked layer can\'t be selected or deleted.
The elements on the layer (%1$d) will be deleted too. You can bring them back with Undo.
The active layer is hidden or locked: unhide or unlock the layer to draw.
Your drawing can be corrected like this:
Last chosen color and text settings
When off, changes are saved with Save at the top.
Autosave is off. Save your changes before leaving?
Canvases (%1$d) and folders (%2$d), including the canvases inside them (%3$d), will be permanently deleted.
Images (%1$d) and folders (%2$d), including the images inside them (%3$d), will be permanently deleted.
Tap a point: select · drag: move (connected lines follow) · Cut: separate the selected points from their lines
Tap a line: a point is added there · tap empty space: free point
Tap a point (or drag from a point), then another: a line is drawn between them
Tap the next point: the line continues · tap the start point again: finish
Tap a line to select it · middle handle: curve · end handle: slope
Take line color from the image
Chosen based on the image: edges for photos, line centers for pen/ink drawings.
Edges where color and light change (photos, color images).
The center of dark lines becomes a single line (charcoal, ink, sketches).
No lines found in the image; increase the detail.
Pick a color and tap an area enclosed by lines; tapping a painted area changes its color. Clear removes the area\'s color.
This area isn\'t closed: tap a spot enclosed by lines.
Tap an element to select it · drag on empty space to pan
Tap where you want to add
Tap the element you want to edit
No correction found for this drawing.
The position of the selection\'s top-left corner on the paper (in pixels). Enter the values and tap Apply.
64–8192 px. Enlarging expands the paper outward from the chosen anchor; shrinking crops from the opposite edges.
Pen mode: toggle drawing with finger
No stylus found. It is detected when you touch the screen with the stylus; passive (capacitive) styluses work like a finger.
Finger pans while drawing with the stylus
When a stylus is used, fingers and palm don\'t draw; one finger pans, two fingers zoom
The harder you press, the thicker the line; pencil, charcoal, pastel, and soft brushes get darker
When the stylus is tilted, pencil, charcoal, and pastel widen and lighten (for styluses that report tilt)
Wherever you draw while holding the stylus side button is erased; the eraser end of the stylus always erases
So the line doesn\'t lag behind the stylus tip, a few milliseconds ahead are predicted and shown temporarily
On Android 10 and above, lines drawn with a stylus are drawn to the screen without waiting (for opaque brushes)
Not supported on this device (requires Android 10 or above)
Text, shapes, and formulas stay sharp at any zoom, and the file is small. Pages where the eraser was used are written as images.
All pages are written as images, as they appear on screen.
At the bottom of the page, like “2 / 5”
Suggests corrections when you stop drawing
Drawing suggestions turned off (can be turned on from the ⋮ menu)
Distance between brush stamps (relative to brush thickness)
How fast the ink catches up with the pen: at low values the line follows your finger with a lag and smoothly
Smooths out shaky, zigzag lines (for this brush)
For tablet styluses that report tilt (Settings → Tablet stylus → Tilt shading on)
The effect starts when the pen is tilted beyond this angle
The flat nib rotates according to the direction you tilt the pen (for styluses that report direction)
Stylus recognized: stylus settings are in use
Stylus not recognized: stylus settings are hidden
Recognized when a stylus-capable screen or Bluetooth stylus is present, or on the first touch with a stylus
Stylus settings are shown and used even if no stylus is detected (for undetected styluses)
The stylus draws like a finger: pressure, tilt, and the side button aren\'t used, and stylus settings are hidden
The line is laid onto the chosen face and extruded by the depth. Drag the circle to rotate the scene; 3D trails and solids rotate too.
3D drawing on: pick a face, set the depth
In Edit → Scale, you can expand the box as much as you like with the handles on its right and bottom edges; Move only moves it.
Drag or tap where the arrow should go · the arrow starts at the shape\'s edge
\"%1$s\" saved and will be applied to the canvas
The 3D shape has unsaved changes. If you save, the shape on the canvas is updated too.
Rotate the scene with one finger · pan and zoom with two fingers
Tap a part: selects it (a group is selected together) · drag a part: moves it · drag on empty space: rotates the scene · two fingers: pan/zoom
Drag a part to rotate it (pick an axis; free mode uses the vertical axis) · a group rotates together around its center
Drag a part right/up to enlarge it · if an axis is chosen, only in that direction · a group scales together
Tap faces to select them · extrude, inset, scale, paint, or drag to move · drag on empty space: rotates
Tap or sweep over the face you want to paint
Draw on the selected plane: choose the type with the \"Type\" button (line or tube, ribbon, wall, lathe, inflate) · two fingers rotate the scene
Sweep the eraser over drawings (3D lines, brush objects): the part it touches is erased · it doesn\'t affect objects · two fingers rotate the scene
Tapping an object adds it to the scene and selects it.
Tap a row: selects only that part · checkbox: adds to the selection · tap a group header: selects the whole group.
No selection: the Paint tool\'s material
Select a part to adjust it.
The mesh was changed by vertex/face editing; object settings don\'t apply.
The Line type draws a 3D line; other types create a 3D object from your stroke (a new part). The stroke is drawn on the selected plane.
The 3D shape will be edited in a separate window. Save the canvas before opening?
You don\'t have any 3D shapes yet. Create one with \"New 3D shape\".
The 3D shape is deleted from My 3D shapes; copies already added to canvases remain.
Tap: add to canvas · pencil: open in the 3D editor
Suggests converting your drawing to a clean shape
Text suggestions turned off (you can turn them on from the ⋮ menu)
Shape suggestions turned off (you can turn them on from the ⋮ menu)
Changes apply to this page only (page %1$d / %2$d)
Tap an edge: select (multiple allowed) · press and hold an edge: new point · drag a point or edge: move
Can\'t do this on this edge (pick an edge where three faces meet at a corner)
Bend: curves the edge outward (+) or inward (−) like an arc
Stretch: lengthens or shortens the edge relative to its center
Push: pushes the edge out of (+) or into (−) the surface
Round: makes a sharp edge curved
Extrude: pulls the face out (+) or pushes it in (−)
Inset: opens a smaller face inside the face
GPU unavailable (%1$s); using the software renderer
High: 4× anti-aliasing · Balanced: 2× · Fast: no anti-aliasing, ¾ resolution (older devices)
Low detail makes editing faster; smooth shading makes curved faces look smooth.
Ready-made shapes for lessons and drawing: tap to add them to the scene.
Tap to open a ready-made shape; when you save it, it\'s added to My 3D shapes.
\"%1$s\" (%2$s) will be imported. Choose a level of detail: low detail edits quickly on any device.
Tap an edge: adds a point · tap a point: selects it (in order) · Connect: joins the selected points with an edge · Cut: turns the region enclosed by the points into a separate part
Tap a surface: the whole surface of the tapped face is selected · drag the selected face to move it · drag on empty space: rotates · two fingers: pan/zoom
Hole width: the part is drilled all the way through from the selected face
Select at least two parts for union, subtract, and intersect (using the checkboxes in the Parts panel). Subtract removes the others from the first part you selected.
The selected part is split in two by the plane, and both sides are capped. The plane is shown in the scene.
Sections that don\'t touch each other (e.g., cut or grouped parts) become separate parts.
If a face is selected in the Face tool, the hole is drilled from that face; otherwise it\'s drilled through the middle of the part, perpendicular to the screen.
Round tube along the stroke; pressure and tip taper change the thickness.
Ribbon with thickness along the stroke (flat band).
A wall rising perpendicular to the plane from the stroke; if you draw a closed shape, it becomes a solid prism.
Draw half of the profile starting from the axis: it\'s revolved around the vertical axis through your starting point (vase, bottle, goblet…).
A closed shape you draw is inflated like a pillow.
At most %d px on this device
JPEG can\'t be transparent: a white background is used
Tap a shape to select it, then press the \"Add 3D shape\" button below · pencil: open in the 3D editor
Ready-made shapes for lessons and drawing: tap to select.
Tap an object or a ready-made shape: it\'s added to the scene · drag the part in the scene to position it
3D lines and objects drawn with the brush are deleted. You can bring them back with Undo.
Single face: the face you tap is painted · press and hold to highlight what will be painted · two fingers: rotate
Surface: the whole surface of the face you tap is painted (e.g., the side of a cylinder, one side of a box)
Part: the entire part you tap is painted
All: tapping paints all visible parts in the model the same color
Select points first: tap a point (tapping an edge adds a point)
Select an edge first: tap an edge of the model
Select a face first: tap a face of the model
Select a part first: tap a part in the scene
Select at least two parts to group them (using the checkboxes in the Parts panel)
Save the imported shape to My 3D shapes as a separate shape?
Image brushes · speech balloons, panels, sound-effect text, pages
Tap a style: a balloon is added and you can type its text right away. Drag the tail tips on the canvas to point them at the speaker.
With the balloon selected in Select mode, drag the points at the tail tips.
Sound effect: large text with a thick outline, shadow, and gradient fill. Its text and colors can be changed later.
Added inside the selected panel if there is one, otherwise across the whole page; it moves as a single element.
Gives the image a comic look; Undo returns to the original image.

The shape you draw (circle, triangle, rectangle, spiral…) is recognized on the device and matching objects are suggested; your choices are learned, so suggestions adapt to you over time. No internet needed.
Shows suggestions when you select an element
Auto-suggest on selection turned off (you can turn it on in Settings)
Move suggestion box (drag; double-tap: return to automatic position)
The values are the numbers in the steps\' text (e.g., \"January 120\", \"Headcount +64\", \"Total =\"); change the text and the chart is redrawn.
Once the balloon is selected, you can also resize it with the handles on its corners. If the height is automatic, the balloon grows to fit the text.
New text takes the pen\'s color (the color in the Brush panel).
The drawing is added to the center of the open page of the canvas you pick; this canvas doesn\'t change.
The 3D shape is added to the center of the open page of the canvas you pick, at its current angle.
Lines and elements are copied; they can be edited one by one at the destination.
Added as a single image (with a transparent background).
There are no saved canvases of this type; you can create a new one.
You don\'t have any saved images yet. When you save a canvas as an image, it shows up here.
Elements hidden: %1$d. You can show them again with the eye button in the Elements panel.
Drawing, selection, and 3D suggestions are on
AI turned on for this canvas.
AI is off on this canvas. You can turn it on from the ⋮ menu.
The background is found from the colors at the edge. Tap the preview to remove or restore a region.
%1$d%% of the image will be removed
When off, only the spots you tap are removed
Background-colored areas such as inside letters or between arms
Background removed (%1$d%%). You can return to the original image with Undo.
Welcome to DrawGuidance. What shall we draw today?
Welcome back. Your drawings are waiting for you.
Pick up where you left off
Draw with guides; shape and text suggestions, 3D shapes, and effects are one tap away.
No server found on the local network. Make sure the server is running on your computer and your phone is on the same Wi-Fi.
Servers found: %1$d. Tap one to use it:
Trying create, read, update, and delete…
Which tools would you like to learn? Each tool in the group you pick is introduced in a box that opens right below, and a professional drawing is made step by step in the drawing area with that tool.
The tutorial runs on a blank page; when it finishes or you cancel, your canvas stays exactly as it was. You can open it again anytime with Tutorial mode in the ⋮ menu.
The tutorial offer shown the first time you enter the drawing, note-taking, and comic modes will appear again
Suggestion bubble: when tapped, the wobbly line turns into a perfect shape. Feel free to tap it yourself.
Template suggestion: when tapped, neat lines drawn with the same brush replace your drawing.
Fix all: every drawing turns into its own clean shape (a single undo step).
Text suggestion: when tapped, your handwriting becomes clean text in the same place and color.
From the ⋮ menu you can turn AI on or off for this canvas; text, shape, and selection suggestions can be turned on separately. Suggestions run on your device and adapt to you as you accept them.

In Select mode, when you select a few elements, a suggestion appears without pressing a button; if one or two elements are selected, parts that would complete the drawing are suggested. Suggest multiple corrections in the selection bar opens the same suggestion.
A sunset landscape with the brush, brush settings, paint bucket, eraser, pen tool, undo, and layers.
Pencil, ink, marker, charcoal, pastel, soft brush, and textures are chosen here. First we draw the outlines of the mountains and hills with the ink pen; pressure thins the line at the ends.
Thickness, opacity, flow, and stroke stabilization. We paint the mountains and hills layer by layer with a wide, semi-transparent marker.
With nothing selected it paints the paper; with an element selected, it paints the inside of that element; solid color or gradient. We give the sky a sunset gradient.
Erases only what was drawn with the brush; shapes, text, and images are kept. We carve out a stream winding between the hills.
Tap to place a corner, drag to place a curve; for clean vector paths. We add birds to the sky with smooth curves.
Every step can be undone and redone; swiping left or right with three fingers does the same. We undo and redo the last bird.
Keep the sky, mountains, and details on separate layers: hide, lock, reorder. You can find and select every piece from the Elements list.
A vector landscape with ready-made shapes, text, Select, Move, and Edit.
Shapes, text, guide and perspective lines, 3D shapes, and images are in this menu. Just pick an item and tap or drag on the canvas.
Hundreds of vector shapes: landscapes, animals, buildings, arrows, charts… Resize them by dragging; they take gradient fills and border colors. We add the sun, mountains, clouds, and pine trees.
Tap the canvas and type: 30+ fonts, bold and italic, border, shadow, text box. We add a title to the landscape.
Tap to select one or more elements; copy, hide, delete. We select the sun.
Drag the selection or nudge it by 1–10 pixels with the arrow buttons. We lower the sun toward the space behind the mountains.
Rotate, scale, crop, and edit vector points. We enlarge the setting sun a little.
Correcting hand-drawn shapes, template recognition, fix all, and AI settings.
Draw a circle by hand and lift the pen: AI recognizes it and suggests the clean shape. We draw the moon.
An object you draw with a few lines is looked up in the shape database and the mode\'s neural network: house, tree, face… We draw a house.
When 3 or more elements are drawn together, the suggestion appears automatically; Fix all corrects them all at once. We draw pine trees.
A physics class note with a title, note pens, highlighter, and pages.
Title, bullets, and paragraphs are written with Text in the Add menu; font, size, and color are in the Brush panel. We add a title to the class notes.
Pencil, ballpoint, fountain, gel, and felt-tip pens; pressure-sensitive, recognizes a tablet stylus. We take notes with the ballpoint pen.
Highlight important parts: it stays transparent over the text. We mark the title.
Add, duplicate, and delete pages and switch between them with the bar at the bottom. You can save your notes as a PDF from the ⋮ menu.
A topic summary with ready-made formulas, a flow diagram, and arrows.
Formulas and diagrams can also be added on a note-taking canvas; select the item, then tap or drag on the canvas.
Hundreds of ready-made formulas from physics, math, and chemistry; every letter and number is editable separately. We add Newton\'s second law and the velocity equation.
Flow, process, mind map, timeline, and more; steps are edited right on the canvas. We summarize the topic with an editorial flow diagram.
Connect notes with arrows and group them with boxes and frames. We draw an arrow from the formula to the diagram.
Handwriting to text, shape correction, and fix all.
Write by hand and lift the pen: it\'s recognized with a Turkish dictionary and language model, and tapping turns it into text in the same place. We write \"kuvvet\" (Turkish for \"force\").
Boxes, circles, and triangles you draw by hand turn into clean shapes. We draw a box.
When 3 or more elements are drawn together, the suggestion appears automatically. We draw three rings that touch each other.
Panel layout, a hero drawn with the ink pen, and focus lines.
In Comic mode, the panel layout, speech balloon, sound-effect text, and speed lines are in this menu.
Ready-made page templates with one tap: two strips, four-panel, manga, webtoon… We pick a large top panel and two small panels.
Ink and fine-tip pens for comic outlines; the line thins with pressure. We draw our hero.
Speed, focus, burst, and tremble lines for motion and emphasis; they\'re placed inside the selected panel. We add focus lines around the hero.
Speech balloon, sound-effect text, and narration box.
Oval, thought, shout, whisper, and narration balloons; drag the tail to point it at the speaker. Our hero speaks.
Ready-made text like BAM!, POW!, and BOOM! with gradients and shadows. We add an effect.
A yellow box that describes the scene; it has no tail. We open the story.
Recognition made for comics: speech balloons, facial expressions, and fix all.
A neural network made for comics recognizes the balloons, bursts, and emotion marks you draw by hand. We draw a speech balloon.
Smiling, surprised, and angry faces are corrected with templates. We draw a smiling face.
When 3 or more elements are drawn together, the suggestion appears automatically. We draw bubbles.
%1$s: used by tapping. Press and hold to see what it does in this box.
Press and hold: what does it do?
Switches to the drawing brush; while on the brush, tap to open the brush picker (pencil, marker, watercolor…).
Switches to the eraser: erases by sweeping over lines. Tap again to return to the last brush.
Pen tool: tap to place corner points and drag to place curved points to draw an editable path.
With nothing selected, changes the paper color; with an element that has a fill selected, changes its fill color.
Chooses the paper background: solid color, pattern, or image.
Opens the Elements panel: lists the elements on the canvas, and lets you select, hide, and group them.
Opens the Properties panel: the selected tool\'s settings (brush size, opacity and color, or text format).
Opens the Layers panel: add, hide, and lock layers, and choose the active layer.
Adds a copy of the selected elements right next to them.
Hides the selected elements; hidden ones can be shown again from the Elements panel.
Deletes the selected elements (while editing a shape, deletes the selected point or line).
Nudges the selection left (by the amount on the step chip: 1 or 10 pixels).
Nudges the selection up (by the amount on the step chip: 1 or 10 pixels).
Nudges the selection down (by the amount on the step chip: 1 or 10 pixels).
Nudges the selection right (by the amount on the step chip: 1 or 10 pixels).
Moves the selection to the exact center of the page.
The selection\'s position; tap to enter the exact position as numbers.
The nudge step of the arrow buttons; tap to switch between 1 and 10 pixels.
The paper size; tap to enter the width and height as numbers.
Chooses whether a finger can draw while you use a pen (when off, the finger pans).
Adds a shape: pick the shape in the picker and drag on the canvas to place it.
Adds a ready-made formula; you edit its coefficients right on the formula.
Adds text: tap the canvas and type.
Adds a diagram (flow, loop, timeline…); its steps are edited afterward.
Adds a speech or thought balloon; drag its tail on the canvas to aim it.
Adds sound-effect text such as “BAM!” or “WHOOSH”.
Adds speed or focus lines (for motion and emphasis).
Adds guide lines: grid, dots, ruler lines.
Adds one of your 3D shapes to the canvas as an image.
Adds a perspective guide: horizon line and vanishing points.
Adds an image from the device (on note-taking and comic canvases, from saved images too).
Opens the selected element for editing by its points (shape, drawing, or path).
Rotates the selected element: drag on the canvas or use the ±15° buttons.
Enlarges or shrinks the selected element: drag or use the ±10% buttons.
Crops: set the area with the handles and apply it with Crop (the paper if nothing is selected, otherwise the element).
Shows the shape\'s points: drag them to move. The panel below also has adding points and drawing lines.
Tap a point to select it and drag to move it; multiple points can be selected.
Tapping on a line adds a point there; tapping empty space places a new point.
Tap two points in turn to draw a line between them; drawing continues from the last point.
Selects the shape\'s lines: you change their slope and curvature or straighten them.
Tapping a closed area of the shape paints it with the selected color.
Graph settings: pattern, number of points, numbers, and grid.
Changes the line color, thickness, and fill of the selected parts (of the whole shape if nothing is selected).
Cuts the shape at the selected points; the pieces are edited separately.
Removes the paint from the tapped area.
Picks a color for area fill that isn\'t in the list.
Decreases the selected line\'s slope by 15°.
Increases the selected line\'s slope by 15°.
Turns a curved line into a straight line.
Decreases the number of patterns or items in the graph.
Increases the number of patterns or items in the graph.
Decreases the number of points (ticks) on the axis.
Increases the number of points (ticks) on the axis.
Shows or hides the axis numbers.
Shows or hides the graph\'s grid.
Paints the area under the function curve.
Marks roots, peaks, and intersection points.
Converts the image to editable lines (with edge-detection settings).
Applies comic filters to the image (ink, halftone, posterize…).
Removes the image\'s background; tap the preview to add or restore regions.
Applies ready-made looks and adjustments such as brightness and contrast to the image.
Adds a new step to the diagram.
Adds an arrow between two steps: tap the start step first, then the target step.
Opens the selected diagram for editing: steps, arrows, and text.
Expands the paper by 10% from the left.
Expands the paper by 10% from the top.
Expands the paper by 10% from the bottom.
Expands the paper by 10% from the right.
Fits the paper to the screen (resets zoom).
Draw: you draw with the brush; the top menu has the brush, eraser, paint, and panels.
Select: select elements by tapping them or drawing a frame; with the selection you can copy, hide, or delete.
Add: adds shapes, text, images, 3D shapes (and formulas, diagrams, balloons… depending on the canvas type).
Edit: opens the editor of the element you tap; rotate, scale, crop.
Move: you move the selection by dragging or with the arrow buttons.
Expand: enlarges the paper from its edges or lets you enter its size.
Finishes the action and returns to the previous mode.
Restores the crop area to its original state.
Changes the shape to be added (opens the shape picker).
Opens text settings such as font, size, color, and alignment.
Edits the text of the selected text element.
Edits the selected shape by its points, lines, and areas.
Changes the speech balloon\'s style, number of people, and colors.
Changes the density of speed or focus lines.
Opens the selected image for editing: crop, vectorize, remove background, effects.
Edits the coefficients of the selected formula right on the formula.
Changes the color of the selected drawing.
Makes the selected drawing\'s line thinner.
Makes the selected drawing\'s line thicker.
Smooths out wobbles in the selected drawing.
Brings up a suggestion to convert the selected drawing into a clean shape or text.
Brings up a correction suggestion for all the selected drawings; one tap fixes them all.
Deletes the last point of the pen path.
Finishes the pen path and adds it to the canvas.
Adds a new page after the open page (up to 1000 pages in comics, 200 in note-taking).
Duplicates the selected page with its contents.
Deletes the selected page (the last page can\'t be deleted).
Saves the canvas now (when autosave is off).
More options: PDF, autosave, suggestions, AI, tutorial.
